title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: The page numbers are not monotone. §53 is given p. 750 while §52.4 is p. 758, and §53.2 is p. 761'. The 750 is very likely a misreading or slip for 760.
§52.2 is read as 744 in the transcription, but the image may read 749. That would sit oddly before 3° at 748.
No mathematical claims are made beyond titles, so nothing can be checked in substance.

ideas.what: Lie approximations (L-groups, TL-groups, discrete and profinite) of the Galois-Teichmüller tower, possibly induced from a 'schematic' approximation
ideas.modern_name: Graded Lie algebra / pro-unipotent / relative completion versions of the Grothendieck-Teichmüller group (grt, GRT, Ihara's stable derivation algebra, Hain–Matsumoto weighted completion)
ideas.where_published: The Esquisse d'un programme (1984) mentions the Teichmüller tower and Gal(Q̄/Q) but not this Lie-approximation formalism as such

ideas.what: Special Teichmüller group of type (1,1) identified with the central extension GL(2,Z)~ ⊂ GL(2,R)^{±}~
ideas.modern_name: Mapping class group of the once-bordered torus ≅ B_3 ≅ SL(2,Z)~ (universal central extension), plus an orientation-reversing extension
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Artin/Milnor; standard in mapping class group literature)
ideas.where_published: The Esquisse discusses T_{1,1} and SL(2,Z) informally

ideas.what: Comparison of topological vs differentiable groups of surfaces and their coverings

missed.claim: Grothendieck planned a formal theory of 'Lie approximations' of the whole Galois-Teichmüller system, discrete and profinite, compatible with schematic envelopes over Z. This predates or parallels Drinfeld/Ihara. The details (pp. 737–760) may contain definitions not in the literature, but this page shows only titles.
missed.quote: Approximations de Lie des systèmes de Galois-Teichmüller ... Approximations de Lie induites par une approximation de Lie "schématique"
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It may show an early, integral (over Z) version of the GT Lie-algebra programme. Comparison with grt and with Hain–Matsumoto completions would require reading pp. 737–760.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a table of contents only. It documents that Grothendieck explicitly organised a 'Lie approximation' of the Galois-Teichmüller tower, an anticipation of grt and related work worth noting historically. The (1,1) material is classical.
transcription_corrections: The page number for §53 is probably 760, not 750 (the image shows '7?0' and its subsections start at 761').
§52.2 page number may be 749 rather than 744.
'GL(2,R)^{±1}~' is probably 'Gl(2,R)^{±}~', meaning the group of matrices with determinant ±1, or the full GL with an orientation sign.
§53.6°) is written as '6°)' with no title, left blank.
